groundRise: GroundArt.LAND_RISE, applied in shared Java during tutorial
sourcePolicy: Immutable imagegen originals, full-frame uniform scaling, true alpha. Freestanding modules with service-pad occupancy; not seamless tiles.
anchorPolicy: Source UV positions are runtime authority. Local XYZ/normal are explicitly inferred from one view and must be rebuilt for another camera.

assets.registrationReview: Two front edges measured from source-inspected alpha silhouette ranges; rear vertex inferred. Uniformly fit actual inverse-projected foundation inside reserved grid-aligned tile occupancy. Source pixels unchanged; exact tile fill and seamless adjacency not claimed.
